title: Freshness profiles
description: How long records stay fresh (Revalidating, V-1 to V-3), after Next.js cacheLife profiles (stale, revalidate, expire) plus two Naive adds: per_phase (stale once the venture changes phase) and live (never frozen into a release; a live hole). The framework's defaults are knowledge/freshness.json; a venture overrides profiles and record assignments under freshness in its naive.config.json. packages/naive/src/engine/freshness.mjs reads both.

default.description: The profile a record type gets when records names none

records.description: Profile name by record type id, or by route prefix (validation, foundation/problem); a route prefix wins over the record type, and the longest prefix wins

duration.description: Seconds, or a number followed by s, m, h, d or w

stale.description: How long an agent may reuse what it read without reading it again

revalidate.description: After this long since it was last checked, the record is stale: readable with a stale flag, to be checked or redone

expire.description: After this long it is expired: not relied on, and not frozen into a release

per_phase.description: Stale once the venture changes phase after the record was last checked

live.description: A fast-changing record (pipeline, money, streams): never frozen into a release, it stays a live hole
